title: Can One-Shot Test-Time Data Augmentation Help with Generalization?
abstract: arXiv:2602.00114v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data augmentation is crucial for model generalization, but existing methods are mostly centered on the training stage. Test-time augmentation, while underexplored, can be practically effective for generalization while avoiding extra model parameters or fine-tuning. Given the increasing training cost and the literature gap, we study whether it is possible to perform effective test-time augmentation using image generation from just the single original image. We first analyze the importance of test-time augmentation, and then design and study a simple yet natural operator named 1S-DAug, which comprises geometric perturbations with controlled noise injection and image-conditioned denoising. We obtain positive results on well-established image-classification benchmarks across four datasets and multiple models, achieving up to 20\% relative accuracy improvement without model training or parameter access. Code will be released.

translated_title: 单次测试时数据增强能否帮助泛化？
translated_abstract: 数据增强对模型泛化至关重要，但现有方法大多集中在训练阶段。测试时数据增强虽然研究不足，但可以在避免额外模型参数或微调的情况下，对泛化产生实际有效的提升。鉴于训练成本日益增加以及相关文献的空白，我们研究了是否有可能仅从单张原始图像通过图像生成来执行有效的测试时数据增强。我们首先分析了测试时数据增强的重要性，然后设计并研究了一个简单而自然的算子，命名为1S-DAug，它包含带受控噪声注入的几何扰动和基于图像条件的去噪。我们在四个数据集和多个模型的标准图像分类基准上获得了积极的结果，在不进行模型训练或访问模型参数的情况下，实现了高达20%的相对准确率提升。代码将会发布。
tldr: 提出了名为1S-DAug的单次测试时数据增强方法，仅从单张原始图像通过受控噪声注入的几何扰动和图像条件去噪生成增强样本，无需模型训练或参数访问即可实现高达20%的相对准确率提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes 1S-DAug, a one-shot test-time data augmentation operator that generates augmented samples from a single original image via geometric perturbations with controlled noise injection and image-conditioned denoising, achieving up to 20% relative accuracy improvement without model training or parameter access.
